name: Spirit-Armored Centipede
description: A segmented horror the length of a tall man, armor-plated in glistening black. Its pincers open and close with a small patient sound, like scissors waiting for silk.

name: Grey Disciple
description: A lean cultivator in dust-colored robes. Ink-dark tattoos of creeping insects cover his forearms, and when he breathes, a sweet-sour tang rides the air.
